findings.explanation: Your payment is conditional on the client generating and collecting net revenue and is subject to cost deductions controlled entirely by the client.
findings.suggested_change: Within thirty (30) days of the end of each quarter during the term of this agreement, the Client shall provide a detailed accounting statement and remit the payment due to the Contractor for that quarter.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. Before proceeding with my signature, I would like to suggest a modification. - The relevant clause makes payment conditional on the client generating and collecting net revenue and subject to cost deductions controlled entirely by the client, so I propose we change this so that within thirty (30) days of the end of each quarter during the term of this agreement, the Client shall provide a detailed accounting statement and remit the payment due to the Contractor for that quarter. Please let me know if you are comfortable with this update. Best regards,
